title: Articles: a, an, the
intro: Bangla has no articles, so this is the most common mistake Bangladeshi speakers make. Fix it once, and your English suddenly sounds much more natural.
introBn: আর্টিকেল ঠিক হলেই আপনার ইংরেজি অনেক বেশি স্বাভাবিক শোনাবে।

units.title: A / an: one of many
units.idea: Use a/an for one countable thing that is new to the listener, or to say what someone or something is.
units.ideaBn: বাংলায় 'একটা' প্রায়ই বলি না, কিন্তু ইংরেজিতে একবচন countable noun-এর আগে a/an লাগবেই।

formula.name: A or an
formula.pos: a + consonant sound (a car, a university) · an + vowel sound (an apple, an hour)

formula.name: Jobs
formula.pos: He is a doctor. She is an engineer.

uses.rule: Jobs and roles always take a/an.
uses.bn: পেশার আগে a/an বাদ দেবেন না।

uses.ex: an hour, an MBA, a uniform, a European company

uses.rule: First mention = a; second mention = the.
uses.ex: I bought a laptop. The laptop is very fast.
Twice a day, 500 taka a kilo.

traps.bn: উচ্চারণ স্বরধ্বনি দিয়ে শুরু হলে an।

drills.s: I'm ___ software engineer at a bank.

drills.x: Hour starts with a vowel sound (h is silent).

drills.s: Take this medicine three times ___ day.

drills.q: আমি একটা নতুন ফোন কিনেছি। ফোনটা খুব দামি।
o: I bought a new phone. The phone is very expensive.
I bought new phone. Phone is very expensive.
I bought the new phone. A phone is very expensive.
I bought a new phone. A phone is very expensive.
drills.a: I bought a new phone. The phone is very expensive.

drills.s: I have ___ honours degree in Accounting.
It is ___ honour to serve this community.

units.title: The: the one we both know
units.idea: Use the when the listener knows which one: mentioned before, only one exists, or the rest of the sentence makes it clear.
units.ideaBn: শ্রোতা জানে কোনটা — তখন the। 'ওই', 'টা', 'টি' বোঝালে প্রায়ই the।

formula.name: Known thing
formula.pos: the + noun the listener can identify

formula.name: Unique
formula.pos: the sun, the internet, the government, the CEO

uses.ex: Can you close the door? Where is the manager?

uses.rule: Defined by a phrase after it.
uses.ex: The report you sent yesterday has a mistake.
the best option, the first time, the last slide

uses.rule: Some country names, rivers, seas, plural names.
uses.ex: the USA, the UK, the Padma, the Bay of Bengal, the Netherlands

traps.right: The sun rises in the east.

traps.wrong: He is best player in team.
traps.right: He is the best player in the team.

drills.s: Could you turn off ___ AC? It's cold.
This is ___ cheapest plan we offer.
Did you read ___ email I sent this morning?

o: Padma is the longest river in Bangladesh.
The Padma is longest river in Bangladesh.
The Padma is the longest river in Bangladesh.
Padma is longest river in the Bangladesh.
drills.a: The Padma is the longest river in Bangladesh.
drills.x: Rivers take the; superlatives take the; Bangladesh takes none.

o: The manager isn't in the office today.
A manager isn't in an office today.
The manager isn't in office the today.
drills.a: The manager isn't in the office today.
drills.x: Both known in the situation: the manager, the office.

drills.s: I read about it on ___ internet.
This is ___ first time I've led a meeting.

units.title: No article: general ideas
units.idea: No article for general plural or uncountable nouns, most names, meals, and places like school, work or hospital when you mean their purpose.
units.ideaBn: সাধারণভাবে বললে (সব মানুষ, টাকা, জীবন) article লাগে না। ঘরের নামে নয়, কাজের উদ্দেশ্যে গেলে go to school / work।

formula.name: General
formula.pos: Money is important. Dogs are loyal. Life is short.

formula.name: Purpose
formula.pos: go to school / work / bed / hospital / university · at home

uses.rule: General plural and uncountable: no article.
uses.ex: Customers expect fast replies. Information is power.
The customers in this branch are happy.

uses.rule: go to work / school / bed / hospital for their purpose.
uses.ex: She's in hospital. (patient) / She went to the hospital to visit him.

uses.rule: Meals, days, months, languages, most countries: none.
uses.ex: We had lunch on Monday. I speak Bangla. He lives in Canada.

uses.rule: go to office ✗ — say go to the office or go to work.
uses.ex: I go to the office by bus.

traps.right: I go to the office at 9. / I go to work at 9.
traps.why: Office is not in the school/work group.
traps.bn: 'অফিসে যাই' = go to work বা go to the office।

traps.wrong: We had a lunch with client.
traps.right: We had lunch with the client.
traps.why: Meals: no article; known client: the.

drills.s: I usually go to ___ work by metro.

o: The money can't buy the happiness.
A money can't buy a happiness.

drills.s: ___ people in my team are very helpful.

drills.q: সে ইংরেজি আর আরবি দুটোই বলতে পারে।
o: She can speak English and Arabic.
She can speak the English and the Arabic.
She can speak an English and Arabic.
She can speak English and the Arabic.
drills.a: She can speak English and Arabic.

drills.s: My uncle has been in ___ hospital since Friday.
drills.x: British English: in hospital as a patient. 'In the hospital' is American.

drills.s: Let's meet at ___ school gate at 4.
drills.x: A specific place, not the purpose.

o: The online shopping is growing in the Bangladesh.
Online shopping is growing in Bangladesh.
An online shopping is growing in Bangladesh.
Online shopping is growing in the Bangladesh.
drills.a: Online shopping is growing in Bangladesh.
drills.x: General activity and country name: no article.

mastery.s: Please find attached ___ invoice for March.
I'd like to work for ___ international company.

o: She is a best student in class.
She is the best student in the class.
She is best student in the class.
She is the best student in class the.
mastery.a: She is the best student in the class.

mastery.s: ___ teachers work very hard in this country.

o: I have a breakfast every morning.
I have the breakfast every morning.
I have breakfast every the morning.

mastery.s: This app is ___ useful tool for students.
Could I speak to ___ person in charge, please?

o: I'm going to the office now.
I'm going to an office now.
mastery.a: I'm going to the office now.

decide.q: Is it a singular countable noun mentioned for the first time, or a job?
Does the listener know exactly which one (mentioned, unique, best/first)?
Is it general: plural, uncountable, meal, language, most countries?
decide.no: Check: school / work / bed / hospital for their purpose take no article.
